# eci_kubernetes_node_pool (Resource)

Managed Kubernetes Node Pool

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "eci_kubernetes_node_pool" "workers" {
  cluster_id      = eci_kubernetes_cluster.my_cluster.id
  name            = "workers"
  target_replicas = 3

  node_pool_spec = {
    image_id         = "2c4e6a8b-0d1f-4e3a-9b5c-7d9e1f3a5b7c"
    storage_size_gib = 100
    pricing_ids = {
      vm_allocation = data.eci_pricing.vm_pricing.id
      block_storage = data.eci_pricing.storage_pricing.id
      public_ip     = data.eci_pricing.ip_pricing.id
    }
  }

  username = "elice"
  password = var.node_password

  tags = {
    "created-by" : "terraform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) id of kubernetes cluster that the node pool joins
- `name` (String) name of the node pool
- `node_pool_spec` (Attributes) spec of the nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pool_spec))
- `password` (String, Sensitive) login password of the nodes. It cannot be changed after creation.
- `tags` (Map of String) User-defined metadata of key-value pairs
- `target_replicas` (Number) number of nodes (1 to 64)
- `username` (String) login username of the nodes

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) the time when the node pool is created
- `current_replicas` (Number) number of nodes currently running
- `current_version` (String) kubernetes version that the nodes currently run
- `deleted` (String) the time when the node pool is deleted
- `id` (String) unique identifier of the node pool
- `modified` (String) the last time when the node pool is modified
- `organization_id` (String) id of organization that the node pool belongs to
- `ready` (String) the time when the node pool became ready
- `status` (String) status of the node pool
- `target_version` (String) kubernetes version of the nodes, following the cluster
- `zone_id` (String) id of zone that the node pool belongs to

<a id="nestedatt--node_pool_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pool_spec`

Required:

- `image_id` (String) id of kubernetes node image of the target version
- `pricing_ids` (Attributes) pricing plans of resources created for the nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pool_spec--pricing_ids))
- `storage_size_gib` (Number) size of each node's block storage in GiB

<a id="nestedatt--node_pool_spec--pricing_ids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pool_spec.pricing_ids`

Required:

- `block_storage` (String) id of pricing plan for the node block storages
- `public_ip` (String) id of pricing plan for the node public ips
- `vm_allocation` (String) id of pricing plan for the node VM allocations
